title: Efficacy of Tiotropium in Patients of African Descent With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to look at the benefits of tiotropium, an approved drug for the treatment of bronchospasm associated with COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease), in a population of patients with COPD who are of African American descent.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female of African descent
* 40 years of age or older
* Diagnosis of COPD
* History of smoking at least one pack per day for at least 10 years
* Currently experiencing shortness of breath at least with exertion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Asthma
* Recent myocardial infarction or hospitalization for congestive heart failure
